name: Liquid Glass
author: fasi96
description: Apple-style Liquid Glass for your terminals: thick glass edges that bend what's behind them and catch the light as you move, a slow oil film, and Glass Tuner to adjust all of it live. The bar button sets it up on first click (it builds a Hyprland plugin with hyprpm, so it asks for your password), then opens the tuner.

barWidget.description: Set up Liquid Glass, open Glass Tuner, turn the glass on and off.
